entities.summary: Nikolai Georgiyevich Lebedev was a Red Army major general. Lebedev served in both the Eastern Front and Soviet-Japanese War. He later served as head of the Soviet Civil Administration in Korea from 1947 to 1948. He is considered as one of the founders of North Korea and the ruling Workers' Party of Korea.
